Manchester sports law firm Centrefield has secured investment from private equity house Palatine to fund domestic and international expansion. The Manchester-based firm, which acts for most Premier League clubs and a roster of international sporting organisations, is targeting growth in the US and key European markets through organic expansion and acquisitions.
